description: C1: the first land beyond the rim - a high cold upland north of the Stonehold, opened by the Breach when the Stone Throne was taken. Its bounds cover the three rows of chunks north of the Old Kingdom.
journal_note: Beyond the rim the throne's fall split open: a high, frost-bitten upland of the old giant kings' works - their causeway, the Fallen King, the chain anchors that bind the Worldbreaker under the mountains - and the Rimstone, the first standing stone of the colossi. A handful of hold-outs shelter at Last Hearth. Far to the north-east, on the heights, something cold is waking.
